title: Mogusguy's realism hardcore pack.
description: This project contains lots of mods put together for the ultimate realism experience.
body:
# Hardcore Realism

This is a hardcore realism-focused modpack created for a long-term survival world with Mogusguy and Chunk_Borderzzz. Every mechanic is designed to make Minecraft feel more grounded, intense, and unforgiving, while still being fun to master.

Survival is no longer simple. Food spoils, temperatures matter, tools wear down faster, and the environment is just as dangerous as the mobs. You will need to plan ahead, manage resources carefully, and think realistically about how you build, travel, and fight.

Exploration is slower and more meaningful. The world feels alive, dangerous, and immersive, with tougher enemies, deeper progression, and limited second chances. Death is heavily punished, making every decision count.

## This modpack is built for:
- Hardcore survival experience  
- Maximum immersion and realism  
- Long-term worlds with real risk  
- Players who enjoy challenge, preparation, and strategy  

There are no shortcuts. Only skill, planning, and teamwork will keep you alive.
